description_en: Modifies the parameters of a Cloud Assistant command
description_zh: 调用ModifyCommand修改一条云助手命令相关参数
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-command --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --command-id c-hz01272yr520000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCommand

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The command ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64843.html to query all available command IDs
parameters.help_zh: 命令ID。您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64843.html查询所有可用的CommandId
parameters.name: command_id

parameters.help_en: The command name. The name supports all character sets and can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 命令名称。支持全字符集，长度不得超过128个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The command description. The description supports all character sets and can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 命令描述。支持全字符集，长度不得超过512个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated and does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，传入该参数不会生效
parameters.name: command_content

parameters.help_en: The execution path. The path can be up to 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 执行路径。长度不得超过200个字符
parameters.name: working_dir

parameters.help_en: The maximum timeout period for the command to run on ECS instances. Unit: seconds. If the command cannot be completed within the specified timeout period, the command process is forcefully terminated by canceling the PID of the command
parameters.help_zh: 您创建的命令在ECS实例中执行时最大的超时时间，单位为秒。当无法在配置的时间内运行并完成您创建的命令时，会出现超时现象。超时后，会强制终止命令进程，即取消命令的PID
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The bootstrap program for script execution. The value can be up to 1 KB in length
parameters.help_zh: 脚本执行的引导程序。长度不能超过 1 KB
parameters.name: launcher
